2607.18985.title: Athena-Brain Technical Report: An Efficient Robot Brain for General Intelligence and Embodied Interactio
2607.18985.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in language understanding, reasoning, and world knowledge. As embodied agents become increasingly capable, there is a growing demand for compact models that can serve as an on-device brain, preserving the broad general intelligence of LLMs while enabling effective high-level interaction with embodied environments. Existing approaches, however, often prioritize either general-purpose intelligence or specialized embodied capabilities, making it challenging to satisfy both requirements within a single model. We present \textbf{Athena-Brain-8B}, an 8B LLM designed to serve as an on-device brain for embodied intelligence for embodied intelligence. Through a multi-stage post-training pipeline consisting of General Supervised Fine-Tuning, General Reinforcement Learning, Embodied Expert training, and Model Merge, Athena-Brain-8B maintains strong general capabilities while acquiring strong high-level embodied interaction capabilities and generating concise responses for efficient embodied interaction. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of Athena across both general and embodied evaluations. Compared with the corresponding Qwen3-8B thinking model, Athena-Brain-8B achieves comparable performance on general language and reasoning benchmarks while generating substantially shorter responses. On in-domain embodied benchmarks, Athena-Brain-8B consistently outperforms models of similar scale and surpasses several substantially larger frontier models evaluated zero-shot, demonstrating that compact language models can effectively integrate strong general intelligence with embodied capabilities.
2607.18985.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在語言理解、推理和世界知識方面展現了卓越的能力。隨著具體化代理變得越來越強大，對於能夠作為設備內腦的緊湊模型的需求日益增加，這些模型能夠保留LLMs的廣泛通用智慧，同時實現與具體化環境的有效高層互動。然而，現有的方法往往優先考慮通用智慧或專門的具體化能力，使得在單一模型中滿足這兩個要求變得具有挑戰性。我們提出了\textbf{Athena-Brain-8B}，這是一個設計用作具體化智慧的設備內腦的8B LLM。通過一個多階段的後訓練流程，包括通用監督微調、通用強化學習、具體化專家訓練和模型合併，Athena-Brain-8B在保持強大通用能力的同時，獲得了強大的高層具體化互動能力，並生成簡潔的回應以實現高效的具體化互動。實驗結果顯示，Athena在通用和具體化評估中都展現了其有效性。與相應的Qwen3-8B思考模型相比，Athena-Brain-8B在通用語言和推理基準上達到了可比的性能，同時生成了顯著更短的回應。在領域內的具體化基準上，Athena-Brain-8B始終超越了類似規模的模型，並超越了幾個在零樣本評估中被評估的顯著更大型的前沿模型，顯示出緊湊語言模型能夠有效地將強大的通用智慧與具體化能力整合。
